parameters.query:
-- Init : resolve IDs + create fec_import + truncate staging
-- Tout en une seule transaction pour cette structure

WITH ids AS (
  SELECT e.id AS entite_id, ex.id AS exercice_id, e.code
  FROM entite e
  JOIN exercice ex ON ex.entite_id = e.id AND ex.cloture = false
  WHERE e.code = '{{ $json.code }}'
  ORDER BY ex.date_debut DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
new_import AS (
  INSERT INTO fec_import (entite_id, exercice_id, source, statut)
  SELECT entite_id, exercice_id, 'pennylane', 'en_cours'
  FROM ids
  RETURNING id AS fec_import_id, entite_id, exercice_id
)
SELECT ni.fec_import_id, ni.entite_id, ni.exercice_id, ids.code
FROM new_import ni
CROSS JOIN ids;

TRUNCATE TABLE _staging_fec;

meta.description: Sync ecritures comptables 4 structures Pennylane -> Supabase (format FEC). Pattern : staging -> upsert idempotent -> refresh. Fingerprint MD5 anti-doublons. Tokens via env vars Coolify.
